products.name: ModeDo
products.tagline: A productivity app organized around how you actually work.
products.shortDescription: ModeDo helps people organize tasks with less noise, clearer context, and a calmer daily workflow.
longDescription: ModeDo is a productivity-focused app built around modes so people can separate work, personal tasks, planning, and focus time without wrestling with one crowded list.
The product is designed to feel lightweight and practical. It gives users a clear place to capture tasks, move through priorities, and stay oriented throughout the day.
As Ovrimo adds more software over time, ModeDo sets the tone for the kind of products we want to build: thoughtful tools that are useful, simple, and polished.

screenshots.caption: A clean daily view focused on the tasks that matter right now.
Mode-based organization helps users switch context without clutter.

features.title: Mode-based organization
features.description: Separate tasks by context so people can focus on the right work at the right time.

features.title: Clean daily planning
features.description: A simple interface keeps planning readable and avoids unnecessary overhead.

features.title: Helpful structure
features.description: Tasks, reminders, and flow are organized to support follow-through instead of distraction.

features.title: Cross-device access
features.description: ModeDo is available on the web today, with room for expanded platform support later.

faq.question: What does ModeDo do?
faq.answer: ModeDo is a productivity app that helps people organize and complete tasks using clear modes instead of one crowded task list.

faq.question: Where can I access ModeDo?
faq.answer: ModeDo is available on the web at modedo.app.

faq.question: Is ModeDo the only Ovrimo product?
faq.answer: It is the first live product listed on the site. The product system is set up so more Ovrimo apps and tools can be added later without changing page templates.
